Subject: Northbridge - logo mention & testimonial license (MSA redline coordination)

Team —

Northbridge returned our MSA with two items that need legal sign-off before I send back a clean copy to their counsel: 1) they want an unlimited "reference rights" clause (they asked for the ability to publicly list us as a vendor, and to use our logo in perpetuity across marketing), and 2) a short testimonial paragraph (they want to include a named quote from their CEO in a joint press announcement).

Their ask is in the attached NB_MSA_Redlines_v2.docx (see sections 5.2 and 7.1). From a product / customer success point of view we'd like to be as permissive as possible, but legal flagged the following risks:
- perpetual, irrevocable license to use our logo without brand-guideline constraints
- testimonial language that could imply endorsements beyond the scope of the engagement
- timing: they asked for a simultaneous press release on go-live date (no embargo window)

Can you please:
- Laura: propose specific redline language we can send back that preserves an explicit brand-guidelines requirement and limits testimonial usage to a short pre-approved quote (and add an embargo window suggestion)
- Monica: confirm whether we can provide a small customer logo asset package and a standard attribution line for the website
- Ben: FYI from marketing — any operational constraints on delivering the logo pack and approval flow?

Aim to get a consolidated response I can share with Alyssa (Northbridge) by end of day tomorrow. Attaching a short redline-summary-notes.txt to help speed review.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Sr. Sales Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

Irene —

Thanks for the write-up and the redlines. Quick thoughts after an initial pass (see inline summary / suggested language below). I also attached a tracked redline but pasted the key items here so you can escalate quickly: 

1) Logo use / brand guidelines (section 5.2)
Proposed: "Customer may use Supplier's name and logo solely in accordance with Supplier's published brand guidelines (a copy of which is attached as Exhibit X). Any use beyond the guidelines requires prior written approval. License granted is non-exclusive, revocable, and limited to the term of the Agreement, excepting aggregate references (e.g., in case studies) which may be retained for up to 12 months post-termination unless otherwise agreed)."

Rationale: avoids perpetual, irrevocable grant and keeps brand control. If marketing wants permanent inclusion in a partner page we can carve that as a separate one-time agreement.

2) Testimonial / quote (section 7.1)
Proposed: "Customer may publish a testimonial consisting of a single short sentence (up to 50 words) provided that Supplier approves the final wording in writing. Any testimonial shall be limited to factual descriptions of Customer's use of the Services and shall not be a general endorsement or imply Supplier's endorsement of Customer or vice versa. Supplier may request removal or correction if the testimonial contains inaccurate or misleading statements."

3) Press timing / embargo
Proposed: "No public announcement referencing the Supplier in press releases shall be made until both parties have approved the final release in writing, such approval not to be unreasonably withheld. Requests for simultaneous announcements should be coordinated at least five (5) business days in advance to allow for approval and brand asset delivery; in urgent cases, Supplier will use commercially reasonable efforts to expedite."

4) Clean-up items: add an Exhibit for logo specs and an approval email address (marketing@redwoodinference.com) in the approvals table.

Monica: if you confirm asset readiness and Ben confirms the 5-business-day turnaround, I'll incorporate these edits into the redline and send to Alyssa with a short rationale paragraph.

-Laura
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference
